Release radar shows albums. I also think Release Radar is too focused on individual songs. When a new song is part of an album or EP, I have to open the artist or album page separately to listen to the other new tracks, which is tedious. A user-friendly solution would be to add an album or expand button next to songs that are part of a new album or EP. When clicked, it could expand the playlist inline and show the other tracks from that release between the current song and the next Release Radar song. This way, users could quickly discover the full release without leaving the playlist. If someone expanded every album, Release Radar would effectively become a larger playlist containing all new album tracks, but only when the user chooses to open them
